messages:
rachel: Alert from telemetry EU-WEST high 5xx spike. Deploybot auto-paused the 17:00 slot. Can we confirm an emergency hold and a short mitigation plan?

deploy-bot: [automated] paused release slot 2026-05-03T17:00Z due to service.edge 5xx > threshold. Paused window: 17:00-17:30. Reason: ingress proxy queue drops detected.

miguel: Confirming hold. Proposal: pin canary to v4.2.1 (last-known-good), set slot DO_NOT_REQUEUE, and create a tentative micro-staggered slot at 20:30 with 3m cadence.

oscar: I see correlation with yesterday's runtime tweak `mini-batch-throttle` set to 50ms. Recommend flipping it back to 0 on canaries only and restarting edge pods.

sre-oncall: Oncall here  applying canary-only patch: `kubectl patch cm edge-runtime -n infra -p '{"data":{"mini-batch-throttle":"0"}}'` then `kubectl rollout restart ds/edge-runtime`. ETA ~9m.

miguel: Running pin: `releasectl pin --slot 17:00 --version v4.2.1 --note "incident hold - ingress 5xx"` and flagging DO_NOT_REQUEUE.

oscar: Patch applied; canary pods restarted. Early signal: 5xx down ~42% on canaries after 4m. Monitoring latency and kv-hit-rate.

rachel: Drafted short customer blurb and posted to #ops-status: "We're pausing scheduled releases in EU-West due to elevated request errors. Engineers are investigating and will update in 30m."

sre-oncall: No infra alarms currently. Holding watch for 20m before recommending clearance.

miguel: Deploybot created tentative slot 2026-05-03T20:30Z (stagger 3m). Backfill policy: emergency hotfixes and doc-only changes. Original slot flagged DO_NOT_REQUEUE.

oscar: Leaving traces and a short how-to for reverting the canary patch if needed.

rachel: Action recap: miguel = pin & tentative slot; oscar = canary patch & traces; sre-oncall = infra watch; rachel = customer comms + incident ticket. Reconvene here in 25m.
